title: Delta flights in and out of Atlanta delayed due to system outage

content.summary: A Delta Air Lines Airbus A220. | Photo: Saul Loeb / AFP via Getty Images All Delta flights in and out of Atlanta are facing significant delays on Sunday due to a problem with the system that calculates a plane's weight and balance. Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport is Delta's largest hub and one of the busiest airports in the world. While only Delta is impacted at the moment, disruptions at Hartsfield-Jackson could potentially affect other airports and airlines if delays continue to pile up. The issues with Delta's systems in Atlanta come just one week after an FAA outage led to a nationwide groundstop and thousands of canceled flights.
